messages:
rachel: Quick probe — can we top up UK-east inference pool with 4x A100 for an overnight canary? Need capacity for a 02:30 UTC canary run. @kai @omar

kai: Vendor update — next rack ETA ~00:00 UTC but it's prioritized for staging. We might be able to borrow 2x A100 for a short window.

omar: I can free 2x from staging at ~01:45 if no one else claims them. Who's owning the AMI bake? @jen

jen: I'm on the AMI bake. Plan: build + smoke by 00:45, push to registry, then Terraform apply at 01:00. Also we need a quota bump for uk-east-a100 in the cloud console.

rachel: Filing quota now — submitted request with the expected details and the canary time. Link: https://console.cloud.vendor/quotas/requests/2456 (internal).

rachel: Submitted ticket #2456. Note: cost center infra-demo.

kai: Fallback if quota doesn't come in: spin 4x L40s in eu-west and route canary there. Will that break any tests?

jen: L40s should be fine for smoke tests, latency profile will differ. I'll add a perf flag so telemetry marks the run as comparative.

jen: Terraform snippet for the temporary pool (for reference):
```
resource "redwood_inference_pool" "temp_canary" {
  region = "eu-west1"
  sku    = "nvidia-l40s"
  count  = 4
}
```

deploy-bot: canary scheduled by rachel for 2025-06-02T02:30:00Z — reservation ID res-8791

omar: Thanks — I'll handle tenant ACLs and tagging once the AMI passes smoke. Will post when I flip the labels.

rachel: Awesome. Tagging as async — if quota lands, we'll proceed in uk-east; if not, fallback to eu-west and jen will set perf tag. Ping in #eng-infra if anything blocks overnight :thumbsup:
